🚨 ANOTHER GOLD SIGNAL? JUDY SHELTON IS NOW INSIDE TREASURY

This one immediately caught my attention.

Judy Shelton — one of the most prominent advocates for SOUND MONEY and a greater role for GOLD in the U.S. monetary system — is now serving as a counselor to Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent.

Why does that matter?

Because Shelton hasn't simply talked about gold philosophically.

She has advocated proposals that would reconnect U.S. government debt to GOLD — including the concept of Treasury bonds that could ultimately be redeemable in either dollars or a predetermined amount of gold.

Now put that development alongside the broader pattern we've been tracking:

🟡 Central banks accumulating enormous amounts of gold

🟡 BRICS countries building alternative payment and settlement infrastructure

🟡 China expanding its gold-market and yuan-settlement infrastructure

🟡 Growing discussion about the future of the dollar-based monetary system

🟡 The Trump administration emphasizing U.S. strategic assets and sovereign wealth

🟡 And now Judy Shelton — perhaps one of America's best-known modern advocates of gold-linked money — advising the Treasury Secretary.

Does this mean America is officially returning to the gold standard?

We're tracking SIGNALS.

And putting Judy Shelton inside Treasury while the global monetary system is undergoing enormous changes is another VERY interesting data point.
